mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — Java Developer
mock_interviews.description: Master core Java concepts, multithreading, and stream APIs. This interview challenges your understanding of JVM internals, memory management, and object-oriented design patterns used in enterprise-grade applications.
mock_interviews.instructions: 60 minutes. Includes MCQs, short design prompts, and one coding task in Java.

mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — Python Developer
mock_interviews.description: Dive deep into Python's data structures, decorators, and generators. You'll face questions on asynchronous programming, Django/Flask frameworks, and writing efficient, pythonic code for scalable backends.
mock_interviews.instructions: 50 minutes. MCQs and one coding task; focus on Pythonic solutions.

mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — Frontend Developer
mock_interviews.description: Demonstrate your expertise in building responsive, accessible web applications. Expect questions on React hooks, state management (Redux/Context), CSS architecture, and optimizing browser performance.
mock_interviews.instructions: 55 minutes. MCQs, DOM/CSS problems, and a small implementation task.

mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — Data Scientist
mock_interviews.description: Validate your expertise in statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data visualization. Be ready to discuss feature engineering, model evaluation metrics, and real-world data pipeline challenges.
mock_interviews.instructions: 75 minutes. MCQs, short analytical problems, and one coding/data task.

mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — System Design Engineer
mock_interviews.description: Architect scalable, distributed systems. You'll be tested on load balancing, database sharding, caching strategies, and CAP theorem trade-offs for high-traffic global services.
mock_interviews.instructions: 90 minutes. Design prompts and discussion-based questions; include one architecture diagram task.

mock_interviews.title: Mock Interview — DevOps Engineer
mock_interviews.description: Prove your skills in CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code. This session covers cloud reliability, monitoring, and automated deployment strategies.
mock_interviews.instructions: 60 minutes. MCQs, short scenario-based tasks, and one practical automation task.
